title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1971-12-31
source: Source: KSAN > FM Master reel > cassette > pcm ( Sony ESX HiFi l-750) - Provided by Tim Dalton; Transfer: pcm > Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > WAV 16/44.1 - Transferred by Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > Adobe Audition 3 > Celemony Capstan > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick July 2018

ai_review.summary: Excellent FM broadcast capture of a high‑energy New Year's Eve show, highlighted by a wild Not Fade Away reprise and a soaring Casey Jones.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the upgraded FM source – the hum is gone and the mix is clear, with the DJ’s brief interlude adding character. Musically the concert burns, especially the NFA reprise with Pigpen and Bob and a monster performance of Casey Jones, making it one of the favorite New Year's shows.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise (5‑star) for both sound quality and performance; standout songs noted, no complaints, yielding an almost perfect combined score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Buzz/hum eliminated in the upgraded FM broadcast; clear, crisp mix with brief DJ comments; no reported drop‑outs or muffiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth, high‑energy flow that builds through the first set into a wild second set; DJ interlude adds to the New Year's atmosphere.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as "throwing it down like lightning bolts" – strong, electrifying guitar work.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mentioned in the wild NFA reprise with Pigpen, indicating a lively contribution.
